deployer.purpose: Original contract creator; not a pool withdrawal authority.

guardian.purpose: Immutable Safe guardian for deposit controls, ASP suspension and delayed provider rotation.

aspProvider.purpose: Current-note association-root publisher; not a fund custodian. Read PROVIDER() on the registry for current authority.

officialRelay.purpose: Off-chain service transaction submitter; not a protocol custody contract or TVL holder.

dex.feeModel: serviceFee = floor(measuredGrossOutput * 30 / 10000), paid to the Safe treasury in TOKEN_OUT (WETH for ETH targets); net output is reshielded into the target pool.
dex.feeActivation: Eighteen 30 bps adapters are deployed and verified on-chain (bytecode, immutable fee, treasury, pools, router and path). Fees are collected on any swap through them; official relay service routes, per-asset gas quotes and real-market end-to-end acceptance are separate operational steps and are not attested by this file.

tvlAccounting.basis: Underlying custody balances at the requested canonical block, once per listed pool.
tvlAccounting.liabilitiesMethod: pool.accountedBalance() at blockTag; separate diagnostic, never add to custody TVL.
exclude: deployer, guardian, provider and relay operating wallets
notes, commitments, encrypted balances and their recovery copies
external DEX liquidity already counted by its owning protocol
fee adapters: they hold no balances between transactions; fees settle directly to the Safe treasury
tvlAccounting.stockUnit: Native issuer ERC20 token, not a guaranteed one-to-one underlying share. Apply verified token-specific pricing and issuer multiplier/corporate-action rules.
tvlAccounting.pricingStatus: DefiLlama chain namespace, asset price mappings and adapter acceptance are not asserted by this address book.
